prompt_style: Original painterly high-fantasy strategy-game overworld reliquary landmark, high three-quarter view, isolated transparent object, strong non-color silhouette for 48x48 readability, no people, text, logos, border, scenery, watermark, or copied game design.
runtime_pipeline: Each transparent 1254x1254 generated master is trimmed, proportionally reduced inside a 44x44 box, centered on a transparent 48x48 cell, and appended left-to-right into one 288x48 runtime atlas. Generated masters remain source-only and art/overworld/source is excluded from Linux and Windows release packages.
artifact_field_pipeline: The eighteen already-original transparent inventory identities are trimmed, proportionally reduced inside a 42x42 box, centered on transparent 48x48 cells, and appended in scenario/faction order. This adds a compact exact field representation without duplicating high-resolution generated masters in release packages.
